# Pangea Global Wellness

> Pangea brings every part of a person's wellness together (training, nutrition, recovery, bloods and genetics, daily habits, longevity), helps them build a lifestyle around it, and stays with them through the Pangea app and a yearly in-person "service" at a Pangea location. Not a retreat, a lifestyle.

- [Pangea Global Wellness](https://www.pangeaglobalwellness.com/): philosophy, how it works, the plan for 10 to 20 locations, resorts and centres, story
- [Pangea Phuket](https://www.pangeaglobalwellness.com/phuket): the first location in Kathu, Phuket, Thailand. Muay Thai at Phuket King Muay Thai, yoga, spa and recovery (herbal sauna, dry sauna, ice bath), Pangea Cafe (no processed seed oils), Pangea Resort (11 lakeside air-conditioned bungalows, group training included)
- [Pangea Cafe menu](https://www.phuketking.com/pangea-cafe)
- [Book a stay at Pangea Resort](https://app.phuketking.com/book.html)
- [Phuket King Muay Thai](https://www.phuketking.com/)
